powers.name: Strength Surge
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant an enhancement bonus equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, on melee attacks, Strength-based combat maneuvers, and Strength checks and skills for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Might of the Gods
powers.summary: As a free action, add cleric level as an enhancement bonus to Strength for Strength checks and Strength-based skills. Usable for rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Sun's Blessing
powers.summary: Add cleric level to damage dealt to undead with positive-energy channeling, and undead do not add channel resistance to saves against that channel.

powers.name: Nimbus of Light
powers.summary: Emit a 30-foot daylight nimbus for rounds per day equal to cleric level. Undead within it take damage equal to cleric level each round, and lower-level darkness effects are dispelled.

powers.name: Agile Feet
powers.summary: Your base speed increases by 10 feet. As a free action, ignore difficult terrain for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Dimensional Hop
powers.summary: As a move action, teleport up to a total of 10 feet per cleric level each day, spent in 5-foot increments. You can bring willing allies by spending additional distance.

powers.name: Copycat
powers.summary: As a move action, create one mirror image that lasts for rounds equal to cleric level or until destroyed. Only one can exist at a time. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Master's Illusion
powers.summary: As a standard action, create a veil-like illusion affecting you and allies within 30 feet. Usable for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level.

powers.name: Battle Rage
powers.summary: As a standard action, touch a creature to grant a bonus on melee damage rolls equal to half cleric level, minimum +1, for 1 round. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Weapon Master
powers.summary: As a swift action, gain the use of one combat feat whose prerequisites you meet. Usable for a total number of rounds per day equal to cleric level, and the feat can change each activation.

powers.name: Icicle
powers.summary: As a standard action, make a ranged touch attack against a foe within 30 feet. It deals 1d6 cold damage plus 1 for every two cleric levels. Uses per day equal 3 + Wisdom modifier.

powers.name: Cold Resistance
powers.summary: Gain cold resistance 10 at 6th level, increasing to 20 at 12th level and immunity at 20th level.
